reason: The frozen helper treated an absent inheritance-mode combinedScore as invalid. Exomiser 15.1.0 represents this value as primitive double and writes JSON with NON_DEFAULT inclusion, suppressing zero. One unrelated zero mode could invalidate an otherwise evaluable case. Discovered while exporting raw source-gene evidence from the previous 12-case benchmark; not selected to improve compact outcomes.
semantic_change: Only absent mode combinedScore defaults to 0.0. Explicit null, bool and nonfinite scores remain invalid. Missing contribution evidence remains unknown and cannot establish joint recovery.
unchanged: worst-tied ranking among genes with PASSED alleles
original frozen evaluator/helper and original literal evaluation
review_limit: Post-freeze implementation correction, not externally preregistered. Original and corrected metrics must be reported side by side, with every affected case/arm enumerated by independent audit.
